in_sanskrit.name: Rajanyaar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Prince, Ruler, Regal
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rajanyaar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Originates from the Sanskrit language, Rajanyaar means 'Ruler' or 'Prince'. This name carries the spiritual significance of power, authority, and royalty, often bestowed upon the eldest male child in a family.
